calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-03-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan Clerk: S. Vantree. CSR: S. Wong # 11288

Petitioner CANDIDA DUANA COX was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined. On the record the Court examines the petitioner regarding her residency in San Francisco. Petitioner only has California indentification with a Mountain View address. The Court accepts petitioner's testimony regarding her residency in San Francisco. On the record the Court corrects and initials change to petitioner's date of birht on the petition fron 11-3-1072 to 11-3-1972.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to CANDICE DUANA COX.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
